title: A point of a blowing up lies in the affine chart of a local equation exactly when that equation cuts out the exceptional divisor there
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file divisors.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma characterizes membership of a point of a blowing up in the affine chart of a local equation by the condition that the image of that equation cuts out the exceptional divisor at the point (statement lines 8469-8478). The counted proof is short but has real content in one direction: assuming the equation cuts out the exceptional divisor, it shows that elements of the ideal become divisible by powers of that equation at the point, uses that the equation is a nonzerodivisor there to make the resulting multipliers unique, builds a homomorphism from the blowup algebra to the local ring, and applies the universal property of blowing up to obtain a morphism over the blowing up (proof lines 8480-8503). It is H2: the argument is carried out in the counted span, with the cited inputs being the affine description of blowups and their universal property.
